weekend_note: Heavy rain today (near 100 percent) and 70 percent Monday, then drying out midweek with only 20 percent Wednesday and Thursday. Rain chances creep back to 60 percent Saturday, so picks lean indoors: the Saenger run of Roman Street tonight, Toast Monday, Postmodern Jukebox Thursday and Daniel Tosh Friday, plus Festa Italiana and the beach weekend of the Songwriters Festival if skies cooperate.

news.title: Emerald Coast PBS to launch Nov. 1
news.summary: A new nonprofit will bring PBS and PBS KIDS back to Northwest Florida on channels 53.1 and 53.2 after Pensacola State College ended its affiliation in July.

coverage_note: Weather uses the National Weather Service seven-day outlook (Oct 4 to 10); Oct 11 was not available. Saenger listings reach only Oct 9 from its homepage, and the Bay Center and Blue Wahoos pages were not read. Restaurant statuses are unchanged: Pelican Bar and Grill has not been confirmed open. NorthEscambia.com event pages would not load, so north and west Escambia coverage is headline-level and Gonzalez and Perdido Key listings are thin. Facebook-only events are not covered.
